headline: Nilesh Kumar Jain to step down as CFO of Rudrabhishek Enterprises
summary: Rudrabhishek Enterprises Limited has officially announced the resignation of Nilesh Kumar Jain from his position as Chief Financial Officer. The cessation of his role is effective from October 01, 2026. The company has not yet disclosed a successor for the financial leadership position.
whats_next: Announcement of a new CFO appointment
why_it_matters: Leadership changes in small-cap firms can signal internal management shifts.
